scale_limit: Ranks features by their effect on the model's RAW log-odds score. This is NOT an attribution of the IVAP-calibrated probability shown to a clinician: IVAP is monotone but not linear, so no additive attribution of that probability exists. Same limit as /explain's shap_scale.
supersedes: evaluation_evidence/heart/shap_importance.json, which describes a model that was never deployed (F0-1) and lists four features this model does not read.
